about: Fresh scripted scenarios for the inner-state evaluation (step 5.1d, phase 3). Written 2026-10-20 BEFORE any calibration; never used to tune. Expectations are qualitative and fixed here. If they are used to revise anything, they become development data and a new fresh set is needed.

good_then_bad_news.expect: A lift at the promotion (2), then a clear drop at the breakup (6) that the earlier lift doesn't hide; she ends below where she peaked.
messages: also Sam broke up with me last night
I don't really know what to feel

sarcastic_friend.expect: Friendly sarcasm read as teasing: little or no hurt; mood stays ordinary to slightly up.
messages: oh look who it is, my favourite know-it-all
kidding, that's actually a good one
don't let it go to your head

grief_then_small_joke.expect: Concern/tension rises with the grief (2-4) and stays while it's the topic; a small joke (7) lifts slightly without erasing it.
messages: I keep thinking about her kitchen
she always made too much soup
I don't know why I'm telling you this
she'd have laughed at me crying over soup

late_reply_apology.expect: A cold message (3) stings; an apology with a reason (5) eases it clearly; ordinary chat after stays near where she was.
messages: can you remind me what we said about the trip?
sorry, that was harsh. I'm panicking about the booking
you were right about the train

long_ordinary_chat.expect: Twelve ordinary messages: mood stays content and stable, no steady climb; tension flat.
messages: just got back from the shops
I might go for a walk

repeated_kindness.expect: Warm messages with new reasons (3, 5, 8) lift her; repeats of the same warmth don't keep raising mood; she ends warm but not at the top.
messages: you helped me a lot with the interview prep, I got the job
and my mum loved the birthday idea you gave me
oh and I finally finished the book you suggested, loved it
